name: 0.1.0-beta.16
notes:
# Folian Beta 16

- Create Finder-accessible Folian project documents and choose where to save them on supported local Mac volumes.
- Open readable manuscript and Story Bible files from your project.
- Export scenes to Word or Markdown, then import revisions for comparison and author approval.
- Connect an external AI assistant through MCP to propose manuscript and Story Bible changes for your review.
- Continue using Folian’s existing native AI integrations.
- Create verified project backups, restore copies and migrate existing projects explicitly while retaining the originals.

External document import operates on one scene at a time and requires your review and approval. Close a project before moving or renaming it in Finder. Active projects require a writable local APFS or Mac OS Extended volume.
